Title: Visual Studio Code extension diagnostics + periscope

Body.Content:
We are announcing the new version of the Visual Studio Code extension for Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). This Visual Studio Code extension enables developers to use AKS periscope and AKS diagnostics in their development workflow to quickly diagnose and troubleshoot their clusters.

With the new Visual Studio extension for AKS, developers can now one-click deploy AKS periscope to collect node and pod logs for their AKS clusters via VS Code. Developers can store these logs in their preferred storage account and generate links for easy sharing. Also, with the new version, developers can run a basic health check on their cluster’s network configuration powered by AKS diagnostics and get recommended solutions to mitigate issues.

Learn more.
